name: Notconf
description: NETCONF/RESTCONF device simulator built on Netopeer2 and rousette. Drop-in replacement for Cisco NSO netsim. Designed for testing network automation systems with minimal resource consumption compared to full VMs.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker-first design. Pre-built container images with Netopeer2 and rousette. Custom YANG modules loaded via bind-mounting /yang-modules directory.

eval_notes: Pre-built vendor images for Cisco XR, Juniper JUNOS, Nokia SROS, IETF models available on ghcr.io. Changes via NETCONF or RESTCONF are synchronized through shared sysrepo database. Multi-arch (x86_64, ARM64). Custom YANG modules via bind mount to /yang-modules. Excellent for agentic evals — lightweight, custom YANG models via volume mount, both NETCONF and RESTCONF interfaces. Drop-in netsim replacement means agents can test config operations against realistic device stubs with minimal resources. Best lightweight NETCONF device simulator for Docker. Open-source netsim alternative. Supports custom YANG modules via volume mount. Ideal for CI/CD pipeline testing of network automation code. Excellent for testing network automation without full VMs. Based on open-source sysrepo stack. Pre-built images for Cisco IOS XR, IETF, Juniper JUNOS, Nokia SR OS YANG models. Multi-arch (x86_64/aarch64). Custom YANG modules via bind mount. NETCONF on port 830, RESTCONF on port 80. Debug variant available.
